cases.prompt: We're about to test a shorter checkout form against our current one. Baseline checkout conversion is about 3.2% and we get roughly 4,000 checkout sessions a day. How many sessions per variant do we need to detect a lift to 3.6%, and how many days should we plan to run it?

Our pricing page test just ended. Control: 18,240 visitors, 912 sign-ups. New layout: 18,105 visitors, 1,001 sign-ups. Average order value dipped slightly in the variant. Is this a real win, and would you ship it?
pm checks the experiment dashboard every morning and wants to call it on day 3 bc p=0.04. thats fine right?
new onboarding variant 'won' on signups but week-1 retention dropped?? not sure what to do with this result

Our redesigned pricing page converts better than the old one, but nobody on the team can explain why customers prefer it. Plan six short interviews with recent sign-ups to find out what actually changed their minds: who to recruit and what to ask.

Roll out our new payments service gradually behind a LaunchDarkly flag: 5% of traffic, then 25%, then 100%, with automatic rollback if the error rate goes above 1%. Show me the flag config and rollout plan.
